The '''Shi'kar Straits''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|belt]] formed after a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] hit the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Shi'kar]] [[Species/Legends|species]], obliterating it into many pieces.<ref name="TCW2">[[The Clone Wars 2|''The Clone Wars'' 2]]</ref> It was located in the [[Nembus sector/Legends|Nembus sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Clone Wars, the Shi'kar Straits had become a haven for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]]. The tumultuous asteroids prevented large [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from policing the area. The Shi'kar Straits were visited by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who were trying to track down the [[Zygerrian Slavers Guild]].<ref name="TCW2" />
